analysis.summary: DiffCodeGen is a test-time scaling method for code generation that selects among candidate programs without extra model calls. It samples diverse candidates, uses coverage-guided fuzzing to synthesise inputs without needing existing tests, executes every candidate on those inputs, clusters them by behavioural similarity, and returns the medoid of the largest cluster. Across four models it reports competitive or better results than other test-time scaling methods at a fraction of the cost.
